scenario: At the same moment, you pick a row, top, middle or bottom, and the other side picks a column, left, centre or right.

modelAnswer: "Emily’s tea gives her less than smoothie in every row." "Smoothie beats tea against rolls, sandwiches and snacks." "Without tea, snacks no longer win anywhere, so they go." "Rolls with smoothie is all that is left."
rubric: Judges each person’s choices by that person’s own numbers.
Sets a choice aside only when another beats it in every case that is still open.
Looks again after each removal and explains what changed.
States which pair is left and that it came from the removals, not from the highest number.
